hero.caption: Stacks at Doonsheane Head A short section of coastal path, where access is (unusually for this area) permitted for walkers, gives some precipitous views down the cliffs to the surging sea, particularly around this geo at Doonsheane Head where the waves have cut deeply into the cliffs, isolating a group of stacks. In the further distance, Bull's Head has similar features, including a more isolated stack.
